title: Convex duality contracts for production-grade mathematical optimization
summary: Deploying mathematical optimization in autonomous production systems requires precise contracts for objects returned by an optimization solver. Unfortunately, conventions on dual solution and infeasibility certificates (rays) vary widely across solvers and classes of problems. This paper presents the theoretical framework used by MathOpt (a domain-specific language developed and used at Google) to unify these notions.
